title: Equilibrium radius of a MoSSe/MoS2 nanoscroll
difficulty_reasons: The agent must search a continuous positive inner-radius domain rather than evaluate a fixed candidate.
The energy is piecewise by complete versus incomplete outer-segment turn, so regime consistency and the global lowest valid minimum must be checked.
The result requires independent numerical convergence and local-minimum/stationarity validation.

paper.title: Controlling Spontaneously-Formed Nanoscrolls by In-Plane Janus TMD/Traditional TMD Heterostructures

data.description: Closed JSON specification of the ordered two-segment ribbon and continuum material parameters.

required_deliverables.description: Validated radius, geometry, regime, numerical checks, interpretation and limitations.
